instruction: Redraw this exact same knight character (same chibi proportions, same blue-and-silver plate armour, same red plume, same face, same colours) as a 3D-model reference: standing perfectly straight and facing the viewer directly from the front, symmetrical A-pose, both arms straight and held out diagonally down and away from the body at about 45 degrees, hands open and empty with fingers together, no sword and no shield, legs straight with feet shoulder-width apart pointing forward, the whole body fully visible with nothing overlapping. Plain flat white background, even lighting, no shadow, no text.
